Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.jdbc

Class JdbcDriver

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.jdbc.JdbcDriver
All Implemented Interfaces:
Driver
public final class JdbcDriver extends Object implements Driver
Implements Driver over JDBC connections from a JdbcConnectionProvider.

Each session works on one connection acquired when it opens and released when it closes. The driver is safe to share between threads; it holds no state besides the provider and the cached DriverInfo.

Implementation Note:
Capabilities are derived from the product name: savepoint release for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB and SQLite; transactional DDL for PostgreSQL, SQLite and SQL Server. Other databases report no capabilities.

    • info

      public DriverInfo info()
      Describes the database, reading its metadata on the first call only.

      A session opened before the first call seeds the description from its own connection, so no extra connection is acquired here once a session has been opened.

      Specified by:
      info in interface Driver
      Returns:
      the description, never null
      Throws:
      DriverException - if the metadata cannot be read
      Implementation Note:
      Concurrent first calls may each read the metadata; the first result stored wins.

    • exactDecimalDigits

      public OptionalInt exactDecimalDigits()
      Tells how many significant digits the database stores exactly in a decimal column.
      Specified by:

      Returns:

      Throws:

      Implementation Note:
